definitions.meaning: someone who clinches holds another tightly, as boxers or lovers do
the point that settles a debate once and for all

explanation.surface: A debater's winning point is pictured as something to hug.
explanation.definitionFit: A point that settles a dispute beyond reply is commonly called this; a person who grips in a hold is the other sense.

clue.text: Creature this puma moved across river twice

indicators.note: the shuffled letters lie across, that is around, the repeated river
the letters of this puma are moved about into a new order
twice says the river is written two times in a row

parts.note: the Po is the great river of northern Italy

explanation.surface: A big cat seems to be swimming over a river two times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moved' rearranges THIS PUMA into HIPTAMUS, and 'across' sets it around POPO, the Po written 'twice'.
explanation.definitionFit: The large African river-dwelling mammal is a living animal, so a creature.

clue.text: Beginning to deal with world shortage

indicators.note: the beginning of the word deal is its opening letter only

parts.note: the Earth is our world

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to tackle a global lack of supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: A scarcity or lack of something is a synonym for a shortage.

parts.note: a scrum is the pack of forwards locked together in rugby
p (piano) is the musical direction for playing quietly

explanation.surface: Rugby players creep into an orchard to pinch fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: SCRUMP is a British word for stealing fruit from someone's orchard.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinching fruit from an orchard is exactly what this dialect verb names.

indicators.note: an outfit that protects something wraps around it, so the knight goes inside

parts.note: kit is an outfit of clothing or equipment
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A suit of armour joins with the knight it shields.
explanation.definitionFit: To knit is to unite or bond together, as broken bones do, so to join.

indicators.note: without in the old sense of outside, so the location sits outside the current

parts.note: a place is a location
I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A swimmer is somewhere with no flow of water.
explanation.definitionFit: The flatfish lives and moves in the sea, so it is a swimmer.

clue.text: Bet here as coin thrown about

indicators.note: the letters of as coin are thrown about into a new order

explanation.surface: A gambler places a wager while a coin is tossed.
explanation.definitionFit: A gambling house is the place where you place wagers.

clue.text: Tool has blade: hard to smuggle into jail

indicators.note: things smuggled into a jail end up inside it

parts.note: the slammer is slang for prison
a blade's cutting side is its edge
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: Someone sneaks a heavy implement and a knife into a prison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tool has blade' reads as one picture, but 'has' is only a link: the blade is part of the wordplay, smuggled into the slang word for prison.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy long-handled hammer for breaking stone is a workman's implement.

indicators.note: the drink goes around the compass point, holding it inside

parts.note: to sip is to drink in small amounts

explanation.surface: Buying a round of drinks up north counts as good value.
explanation.walkthrough: SNIP is British slang for something cheap.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sold surprisingly cheaply is informally called this, a good deal.

clue.text: 7 game allowed to get in way

definitions.note: 7 refers to the answer of 7 across, the gambling house, so a game played there

indicators.note: the permitted word gets in, inside, the way

parts.note: a route is a way
let means allowed

explanation.surface: A gambling game that you are permitted to join on the way.
explanation.definitionFit: The spinning-wheel game is one of the classic games of a gambling house.

definitions.note: with expedition means with speed, an exclamation urging haste

indicators.note: done repeatedly, here twice, so the word appears two times

parts.note: to use a machete is to chop

explanation.surface: A jungle explorer hacks through undergrowth on an expedition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expedition' here means promptness, not a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: The pidgin-derived exclamation means quickly, hurry up, so speedily.

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the words that follow, across the gap between them

explanation.surface: A rower is arriving in the Norwegian port of Tromso.
explanation.definitionFit: A blade for propelling a boat; it is the one that rows, so it is a rower.

parts.note: base means low, as in low or base motives

explanation.surface: A sound foundation for a lamp.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft steady radiance is a kind of light.

clue.text: Large liver OK cooked, but too much

indicators.note: cooked means prepared or rearranged, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A big portion of liver is passable when cooked, but it is excessive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' rearranges LIVER OK to OVERKIL, and the L for 'Large' goes at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Excessive force or effort beyond what is needed is an excess, so too much.

parts.note: B is the pencil abbreviation for black
a rat is a rodent

explanation.surface: A dark rat bothering a youngster.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoilt, badly behaved youngster is commonly so called.

clue.text: Become sunnier in resort, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the clue word is to be heard spoken, like another word

parts.note: Brighton is a seaside resort on the south coast of England

explanation.surface: The weather improves at a seaside town, so people report.
explanation.walkthrough: Brighton is an English seaside resort on the south coast.
explanation.definitionFit: When skies clear and the weather turns sunny, the day is said to lighten up.

parts.note: a BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate
a nana is a silly person, a fool, in British slang

explanation.surface: A university graduate meets a silly person in a factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plant' looks like a factory; it is the fruiting tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The tropical tree-like herb bearing yellow fruit is a plant.

clue.text: Stupid and senseless to incarcerate son

indicators.note: to incarcerate is to lock up inside, so the son goes within

parts.note: inane means senseless

explanation.surface: It would be idiotic and pointless to jail one's own son.
explanation.definitionFit: Extremely foolish behaviour is informally called mad, so stupid.

definitions.meaning: gems of crystalline carbon, the hardest jewels
one of the four suits in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: Gems are discovered sewn into a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: Both the gemstones and one of the four card suits share this name.

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to have them within, so home holds company

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: A celebrity stays home and hosts some guests.
explanation.definitionFit: An idolised figure who is widely admired is a hero.

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Cook up a few curry-house dishes.
explanation.definitionFit: To prepare a meal is to produce it, as in fixing dinner.

indicators.note: us is brought into the money, placed inside it

parts.note: a coin is money
taken as written

explanation.surface: A family member brings us a share of wealth.
explanation.definitionFit: A child of one's aunt or uncle is a family member, so a relative.

parts.note: to get someone is to irritate them, and a sewing implement ends in a sharp point

explanation.surface: An impatient demand to stop rambling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get' means annoy, and the question mark signals the pointed object is also in play.
explanation.definitionFit: To provoke or annoy someone is to rile them; the sewing tool has a sharp tip.
